name: browser-use-python
description: Browser automation via browser-use (MIT, Python 3.11+, macOS/Windows/Linux). Persistent daemon CLI, reuse of the user's real Chrome profile for logins, and MCP server over stdio.

browser-use-python.instructions:
Drive a real Chromium browser through the browser-use MCP server (MIT licensed Python CLI).

Workflow: open <url> to navigate, state to inspect clickable elements (indexed), then click <index> / input <index> "text" / keys "Enter" / screenshot <path> / eval "<js>" to extract. The daemon keeps the browser open between calls (~50ms/call).

Login state: by default a managed Chromium (no logins) is used. To reuse the user's logged-in Chrome profile, run `browser-use --profile "Default" open <url>` — cookies, logins and extensions carry over.

Availability: requires Python >= 3.11 and the uv tool (`uv tool install browser-use`; `uvx browser-use install` downloads Chromium on first run). If `uvx` is missing or the connection fails, run `browser-use doctor` for diagnostics, or fall back to Sati's built-in @playwright/mcp for unauthenticated pages.
